scope: Read-only logical audit of existing small reports, ledgers, and manifests; no cache, provider, matrix, or solve was read or run.

top_level_conclusion.reason: The exact certificates are degree-bounded nonmembership functionals at fixed n=8. They are not unit-ideal certificates, and the proposed upward transports have explicit failures.

authority_levels.certified: Recorded in certification/SUPERSESSIONS.md or the certified proof spine.
authority_levels.working_exact: Exact, source-replayed unaudited computation; useful evidence but not silently promoted to the certified spine.
authority_levels.incomplete: Restartable or selected-subsystem state with null mathematical verdict.

ranked_arrows.arrow: active clean pair at order n -> source at n-2 -> minimality or certified six-site contradiction
ranked_arrows.minimal_missing_lemma: A branch-complete, source-labelled PAComp(h) for every h>=3 that produces either an active clean pair or an accepted physical terminal contradiction.
ranked_arrows.d6_d11_relevance: None. Certificate degree D at fixed n=8 is not the site parameter h and does not establish PAComp(h).

ranked_arrows.arrow: hypothetical normalized n=8 X5 point -> live cross cell -> canonical triangle flag -> one of four blocker branches; an active triangle cap -> certified clean descent
ranked_arrows.minimal_missing_lemma: Exclude each of the four literal canonical blocker ideals, for example by an exact rational unit certificate at any degree, or prove a same-source cancellation-clean cap theorem. Promotion of the working-exact cover itself is also still required for certified-spine use.
ranked_arrows.d6_d11_relevance: D6-D10 exact duals prove nonmembership for all four branches, and the direct D11 dual proves direct-branch nonmembership. They therefore rule out low-degree unit certificates; they do not exclude a branch. The three coloured D11 branches have no global certificate or member verdict.

ranked_arrows.arrow: t^D in the homogenized affine ideal for some D -> exact unit certificate on the fixed live-cell cover -> n=8 cover empty
ranked_arrows.minimal_missing_lemma: Either produce an exact membership t^D in I^h, or prove a structure-specific saturation/regularity bound B with 1 in I_aff iff t^B in I^h and obtain a terminal degree-B verdict. No retained theorem gives B<=12.
ranked_arrows.d6_d11_relevance: D4-D11 are exact characteristic-zero nonmembers, hence only a lower bound on affine certificate degree. The shifted D8 dual fails on a literal D12 column, and the current D12 CEGAR state is exact but nonterminal.
ranked_arrows.direction_guard: If a valid bound B were proved and t^B were nonmember, the conclusion would be existence of a point on this exact affine cover, not its emptiness. Calling that a proof of nonexistence reverses Nullstellensatz logic.

ranked_arrows.arrow: finite run of compatible duals -> duals in every higher degree
ranked_arrows.minimal_missing_lemma: Construct a finite-dimensional source-labelled inverse-system module closed under every required contraction, with a degree-raising right inverse preserving every generator annihilation relation and target pairing; alternatively prove an explicit regularity/saturation theorem for the exact ideal.
ranked_arrows.d6_d11_relevance: The X5 contraction criterion fails for every sealed D6-D8 certificate except a one-step direct D8->D9 transport; coloured D8 already fails C1. Direct D8 fails C2 and C4. At D10->D11, coloured transports have 76, 76, and 70 literal violations. Affine D8->D11 shifts work but fail first at D12.

ranked_arrows.arrow: coefficient-level stability in h -> physical PAComp(h) for all h
ranked_arrows.authority: proved coefficient layer plus working-exact counterguard
ranked_arrows.minimal_missing_lemma: A natural physical Cartan/Hasse lift with all source provenance, readouts, rootless/inactive/face-zero routing, terminal promotion, and uniform control for each composed step.
ranked_arrows.d6_d11_relevance: None. The coefficient degree D and site order h are distinct gradings. Exact n=8 computations do not imply n>=10.

x5_four_blocker.D11: direct exact characteristic-zero nonmember; triangle endpoint incomplete at 1,250,001 selected columns and support 1,378,456 over one prime; third-colour and cap-endpoint unresolved

affine251_live_cell.D12: exact resumable exposed state at round 1587 with 2,927,014 columns and support 5,598; no closure, member, or global dual

invalid_inferences.name: consecutive_degree_extrapolation
invalid_inferences.reason: Finite agreement never supplies an upward theorem, and both X5 and affine ledgers contain literal next-degree transport failures.

invalid_inferences.name: noetherianity_gives_bound_11_or_12
invalid_inferences.reason: Noetherianity guarantees some finite presentation for a fixed ideal, not the unproved numerical saturation/regularity bound needed here. Assuming the required bound is assuming the missing lemma.

invalid_inferences.name: finite_nonmembership_implies_solution_or_nonsolution
invalid_inferences.reason: A finite-degree dual is compatible with both a higher-degree unit certificate and a genuine point. It decides neither without a valid saturation bound.

invalid_inferences.name: selected_cegar_dual_is_global
invalid_inferences.reason: The D11 coloured and D12 states have nonempty violation/frontier data and explicit null mathematical verdicts.

invalid_inferences.name: n8_or_degree_D_implies_all_site_orders
invalid_inferences.reason: Homogeneous certificate degree D is not the number of sites. The all-order theorem requires PAComp(h) for every h.

invalid_inferences.name: live_cell_selects_a_triangle_without_all_blocked_hypothesis
invalid_inferences.reason: The live cell enters the chart but does not activate a particular triangle; canonicalization uses the universal all-triangles-blocked hypothesis.
